business_problem: CANCOM had siloed data across ERP, CRM, SharePoint, and other systems, which made it hard to streamline services, reuse enterprise knowledge, and give employees or customers consistent support.
solution_summary: CANCOM had siloed data across ERP, CRM, SharePoint, and other systems, which made it hard to streamline services, reuse enterprise knowledge, and give employees or customers consistent support. CANCOM implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Technology Provider Service Management, Now Assist, and ServiceNow portal. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Technology Provider Service Management runs service-provider onboarding and customer operations; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; ServiceNow portal serves self-service access for employees and customers. The stack also connected ERP, CRM, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Slack so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: Technology Provider Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs service-provider processes such as onboarding, orders, and customer operations on one workflow backbone.

solution_components.name: Now Assist
solution_components.role: Adds generative-AI capabilities such as summarization, drafting, search, and guided responses inside workflows.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow portal
solution_components.role: Provides the self-service front end where employees and customers access the assistant and related workflows.

data_flow: Requests enter through ServiceNow portal, are classified or summarized by Now Assist, and uses context from ERP, CRM, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Slack before ServiceNow AI Platform and Technology Provider Service Management routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience.
business_outcome: CANCOM doubled assistant adoption in a year, deflected up to 80% of tickets across departments, and established one unified platform for employee and customer services.
metrics: 2x Adoption of CANCOM Assistant in just one year
